name: chat-composer
title: Chat Composer
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Growing textarea that sends on Enter, inserts a newline on Shift+Enter, accepts attachments, swaps in a stop button while generating, and leaves a slot for a model picker.

meta.descriptionEs: Área de texto que crece, envía con Enter, inserta un salto con Mayús+Enter, admite adjuntos, muestra detener mientras se genera y reserva un hueco para el modelo.

examples.title: Compositor de chat
examples.description: Área de texto que crece, envía con Enter, inserta un salto con Mayús+Enter, admite adjuntos, muestra detener mientras se genera y reserva un hueco para el modelo.

api.name: onSubmit
api.description: Called with trimmed text and attached files.

api.name: generating / onStop
api.description: Replaces send with a stop button.

api.name: modelSlot
api.description: Rendered at the start of the toolbar.

api.name: labels
api.description: placeholder, sendLabel, stopLabel, attachLabel, and removeAttachmentLabel default to English.

docs: Import ChatComposer from the installed UI file. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.
